glossary.MTD: Month To Date — ad spend from the 1st of this month through today
glossary.MER: Marketing Efficiency Ratio — total Shopify revenue ÷ total ad spend
glossary.ROAS: Return on ad spend — Shopify UTM-attributed revenue ÷ channel spend (our truth metric)
glossary.CPA: Cost per acquisition — ad spend ÷ Shopify attributed orders
glossary.WoW: Week over week — this period vs the immediately prior period of same length
glossary.UTM: Tracking tags on order landing URLs — Shopify ground truth for which ad drove the sale
